reviewer: park: the design drops the kept behaviour 'closed days fetched before a stop stay cached' (sync_days docstring, test_days_fetched_before_a_ban_stay_cached) and Proof names no replacement test
advocate: continue: today's REST pass already discards a range's pages on a mid-range DownloadError, the per-day write was Vision's, and the intent never promised resumability, so record a plan risk instead
decision: continue, after the run amends spec.md and plan.md so that _rest_pass catches DownloadError per range, settles and caches the complete closed days the covered span vouches for, then re-raises, and adds test_days_fetched_before_a_download_error_stay_cached (error on a later page, spot and futures) to Proof
rationale: Both verdicts agree on the facts: today's fetch_range/_rest_pass lose a range's pages on a DownloadError; only the Vision pass gave the per-day write, and the design makes REST the only path.
They disagree on whether that is a kept behaviour: sync_days promises it today for 'retries exhausted', which R4 keeps, and intent line 113 keeps cache and retry behaviours with equivalent tests.
The safer reading keeps the behaviour that exists at the loader level today rather than letting it drop silently under a ratchet line that names only the 418 ban.
The fix is small and concrete (catch, settle covered days, re-raise) and the run can write it into the design itself, so parking for the owner is not needed.
The owner can still overturn this at the gate and take the advocate's risk-line instead.
